scope: Exterior finished product within the decided method (realtime original sun/sky + time-independent precomputed sky occlusion)
camera: 실사 근사 구도 (precision-reference, same framing as the AI exterior image), 1600x1000

ground.sidewalk: Poly Haven Concrete Pavement 02 (CC0), 1.8 m, neutral tint [1.2,1.42,1.72] -> linear albedo ~0.29
ground.openGround: Poly Haven Concrete Floor 03 (CC0), 2.5 m, neutral tint [0.8,1.05,1.43] -> linear ~0.22 (original page: plain 0x8f9488)
ground.curb: same concrete maps, neutral granite tint [0.9,1.2,1.65]
ground.road: asphalt_02 unchanged; tower plaza pavement_04 unchanged

skyOcclusion.source: exportGroundSource() from the running scene: 408 context meshes, 321,218 triangles, tower excluded
skyOcclusion.signature: 3f490e5c (bbox cm + triangle count, order independent); mismatch keeps realtime lighting
skyOcclusion.bake: 512x512 over +-112 m, 32 rays, 24 m, 6.3 s; meanAO 0.883 (was 0.932 with the old 172k-triangle snapshot)
skyOcclusion.receivers: 36 ground surfaces (aoMap) + 335 context facade bindings (aoNode derived from ground AO 1.5 m outside the wall, fades out by 10 m height, strength 0.6)
skyOcclusion.limits: facade term is a derived approximation, not a per-facade bake; tower massing never enters the bake

night.streetLamps: 5 original R3D.lamps positions as SpotLights (intensity 40 in scene units, 28 m, cone 65 deg); always present, intensity 0 by day (no recompile on time switch)
night.leaves: 4 leaf materials: daytime emissive translucency fill (0x6d682f, 0.12) set to 0 at night
night.haze: aerial-perspective colour follows time: day 0xbdcbd5, night 0x1b2433 (was day colour at night -> white skyline)

rotation.method: TOWER360.spin(true) at the reference framing, 2 x 4.5 s windows, previewIntervalMs
rotation.note: local, same slow machine state as the cafe-final run; sky occlusion cost is within noise
